item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); out=[evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]; assert out==json.load(open('report.json')); cases=[({'from':'x','to':'y'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':0},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':True},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':0},p,{'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':2},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})];\\nfor r,pol,want in cases:\\n rb=copy.deepcopy(r); pb=copy.deepcopy(pol); assert evaluate(r,pol)==want; assert r==rb and pol==pb\\nprint(json.dumps(out))\"]}"}
